_comment: Deny-only. There is no allowlist and no ask band on purpose: an enumerated allowlist always misses the tail (git stash, rg, jq, one-off scripts), so the developer gets interrupted anyway and flips to bypass — the exact failure this skill exists to prevent. Keep this list short enough to read at a glance; that readability IS the fine-grained control.
_protectedGlobs_note: Workflow files are NOT protected in developer mode. 'Fix my failing CI' is a top-five task, CI edits are reversible, and they are reviewed in the PR. Protecting them here would block the mode that promises autonomy.
_allowHistoryRewrite_note: true: rebase, amend and reset --hard are daily tools for someone who can read a reflog. Force-push to the default branch is still denied below.
